subject: general
question: In a symport:

options.text: a molecule moves across a membrane dependent of other molecules
both molecules cross the membrane in the same direction
a molecule moves across a membrane independent of other molecules
both molecules cross the membrane in the opposite direction

solution:
The correct answer is __**both molecules cross the membrane in the same direction**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In a **symport**, both molecules cross the membrane in the same direction.
 
• Symport is a type of **cotransport mechanism** where two molecules or ions are transported across a biological membrane simultaneously.
